brief.rules: Provider is Claude Code Cloud; never substitute a same-VM subagent for a cloud worker. Build only your phase; later phases' features stay out. Make no change that risks reliable playout ("Let's avoid any risky changes"); open outputs and open pages keep working. Phases 4 to 7: the design (designs/G<n>.md) lands as its own pull request only after an independent /so grades it A; product code follows in the next pull request; a design that cannot reach A without a behaviour choice the owner has not made goes to him as one question through the coordinator. Migrations (phases 4, 6, 7 only) go in supabase/migrations with the next free number, are additive, are tested on the local stack and in the configured suite, apply before the app that relies on them, and a live-path one (control_*) applies only in a quiet window with no production live (supabase/AGENTS.md); installing a migration and switching a feature on are separate steps. Every check the run can do, it does itself; hardware checks are listed for the owner's final check (phase 9) and never counted as passed. A target the phase 2 numbers prove wrong goes to the owner, through the coordinator, before the phase that depends on it. Never weaken, skip or loosen a test, check, limit or budget, and never write a test-maintenance entry or budget exception to pass a gate (phase 1's owner-agreed Test maintenance lines are the only exception, as its spec says). Never rename persisted identifiers. Public text: plain, no em dashes. Evidence for each phase goes in docs/work-specs/live-publishing/evidence/phase-<id>.md. Keep receipts and messages short. The production_copies switch is ON in production and stays on; if anything a phase sees looks wrong because of it (old pages, refused saves, adoption), tell the coordinator at once: the coordinator turns it off and tells the owner.
